data: Is the solid purple line in the top plot consistently above the green line?

The solid purple line represents accuracy during training, while the green line represents chance level. The question asks whether the solid purple line is consistently above the green line throughout the entire range of the x-axis.

From the analysis of the top plot:

1. The solid purple line starts below the green line at the beginning of the x-axis but rises sharply and surpasses the green line around the 64k mark.
2. After this point, the solid purple line remains consistently above the green line until the end of the x-axis.

Therefore, the solid purple line is not consistently above the green line throughout the entire range of the x-axis. It only becomes consistently above the green line after approximately 64k oracle requests.
